facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Ingrid was told Warwick knows of her visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_44, beat_45); Dunk was never released

facts.text: Warwick says something visits him almost every night and leaves things; Sir Phidipaldi called them Clurichen but later told Ingrid that Warwick knew of her nighttime visits. Who or what is Warwick's nightly visitor?
